note: USACE Marion Reservoir campground on a wooded point in the French Creek cove on the southwest side of the lake: gravel back-in sites, most with a canopy shelter, along the west shore and round a loop at the tip, with a boat ramp at the northwest corner. Water from shared hydrants. --Claude
summary: rec.gov 10177497: 20 sites all 30 A electric, no water hookups (6 community hydrants); $12 all year 2026-2028; 25-55 ft back-ins; two vault toilets; 14 in 30. Lakeview stands (wooded shore fringe). Season not stated (rate is all-year; calendar only shows Nov bookable) - left unset.
flags: WATERFRONT: stored LAKEVIEW stands. With the catalog coordinates on Esri/NAIP, the west-shore sites (1-12) sit 30-60 m from the cove through a belt of trees, and the tip loop (13-20) 20-50 m from the north and east shores through a wooded fringe, with the loop road on the outside at its north edge. rec.gov lists a 'Waterfront Sites' amenity, but no site is on open ground to the water; lakeview through and over the shore trees is what the imagery supports.

WATER HOOKUPS: newly written water false - the description says the sites share '6 community water hydrants' (catalog 'Water Hookup No' on 1-2, blank on the rest); the 'Water Hookups' amenity tag is the hydrants.

SEASON not written: the rate table runs Jan 1-Dec 31 every year and sites are bookable in November 2026, but no page says it is open year-round and the calendar beyond late November is 'NYR' (no information).
SHORT SITES: 4 and 17 are listed at 25 ft (tight for EKKO); 12, 18 and 3 at 30.
PIN 38.3866,-97.1494 is in the trees east of the entry road, ~60 m from sites 10-11 (catalog centroid 38.38664,-97.14944); fine.
PHONE 620-382-2101 confirmed (rec.gov facility phone, Marion Reservoir project office). Website (rec.gov) as stored.
SAND: none - gravel sites in woods.
